response.original_title: NJPW Circuit 2009 New Japan Alive - Day 10
response.overview: NJPW Circuit 2009 New Japan Alive - Day 10 took place on December 5, 2009 at Aichi Prefectural Gymnasium in Nagoya, Aichi, Japan. The main event saw Shinsuke Nakamura defend the IWGP Heavyweight Championship against Yuji Nagata.
